tool_args.rationale: The verified coupled memory mechanism has four unknown parameters, while only five pilot trajectories are available. The extra fine trajectory batch is specified to supply enough observations for identification before numerical fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five similar trajectories leave the four coupled parameters insufficiently identified for reliable confirmation.
The verified mechanism and irregular-prefix guidance specifically call for additional trajectories to identify the memory model.
It does not resolve the memory-model parameter ambiguity.
They do not account for the observed history dependence and coupled transient lag.
